accepted.label: Three types of organizational decisions
accepted.description: Organizations face big-bet, cross-cutting, and delegated decisions, each requiring different approaches for success.
coverage_criteria: Define big-bet, cross-cutting, and delegated decisions and give examples.
accepted.merge_rationale: This candidate stands alone as a clear classification of decision types.

accepted.label: Widespread ineffectiveness of decision-making time
accepted.description: A majority of respondents spend over 30% of their time on decisions, but 61% say most of that time is used ineffectively, leading to large hidden costs for organizations.
coverage_criteria: State the survey finding about time spent on decisions and the perceived ineffectiveness.
Explain why this ineffectiveness is costly for organizations.
accepted.merge_rationale: This candidate provides a standalone survey insight that motivates the need for better decision-making.
